scenarios.title: 1. Check disabled state of Index and Generate Playwright plan buttons
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the 'Index repository context' and 'Generate Playwright plan' buttons are disabled when API is not ready before patch is applied.

scenarios.title: 2. Validate status pill text for not configured API setup
scenarios.purpose: Confirm that the connection pill in the top bar shows 'Setup required' message when apiReady state is false before patch.
